Ep 6: Lasagna Soup Check my bio for the full written recipe!  #soup #lasagna #easyrecipe #onepot #homecook 1 tbsp olive oil 1/2 lb ground beef 1/2 lb ground Italian sausage or pork 1 yellow onion 4 cloves garlic 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp black pepper 2 tbsp tomato paste 24 oz jar marinara or crushed tomatoes 4 cups chicken stock 2 springs basil 8 sheets uncooked lasagna noodles 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese 1/4 cup Parmesan 1 cup ricotta cheese 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 2 tbsp parsley or basil salt and pepper to taste

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Soups so good that they're worth making from scratch. This is the most popular one on the internet right now. Lasagna soup. Now that's the good stuff. To a large pot, add in a squeeze of oil, ground beef and ground pork. Break in the small pieces and once cooked through, push them to the side and add diced onions. Let them caramelize for a few minutes before mixing it all together. Add in garlic, a few seasonings and tomato paste. Once deep red, pour in one jar of your favorite tomato sauce, chicken stock and fresh basil. Try to break lasagna pieces into fours and add them in as well. At this point, I like to scrape up any fond before letting it simmer for 20 minutes. The cheese on top is the best part, just ricotta, mozzarella and parmesan. Whatever you got. Turn off the heat, add in heavy cream, mozzarella and parmesan. Now that's a soup worth making from scratch.
